title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI gate and quality checks
author: Asha Nair
description: Summary: Introduce a per-prompt regression CI gate for the eval-harness to fail PRs when prompt-set metrics regress beyond configured thresholds. Motivation: Prevent accidental quality regressions when prompt sets or prompt templates change and provide fast feedback to engineers. Approach: Add a lightweight CI action that runs a per-prompt eval subset against a stable baseline model snapshot and compares configured metrics (accuracy, BLEU-like scores, and embedding similarity) with alert thresholds. New code includes the CI workflow, a hook library (hooks/per_prompt_gate.py) that supports configuration via YAML and a local baseline cache, and test coverage for the gating logic. Tests: Unit tests for gate thresholds, integration test using a mocked model runner, and an end-to-end smoke test in GH Actions that runs on a small prompt sample. Rollout: Gate is enabled in draft mode for the redwood repo while the threshold tuning is performed; enabled as blocking for non-draft PRs after 1 week. Migration notes: none required for consumers of the eval-harness. CI details: initial run had a flaky embedding comparison failure; addressed by adding deterministic seeding and tightening the threshold selection. See related Linear items ENG-5021 and ENG-5045 for threshold tuning and docs updates.
